name: Range Trading
market_conditions: price oscillating between clearly defined upper and lower boundaries
ADX below 20 indicating absence of a trend
at least two confirmed touches of both the upper and lower boundaries
market in accumulation or distribution phase
no imminent breakout catalyst or news event
phase_requirements: accumulation phase with defined range boundaries
distribution phase with defined range boundaries
consolidation phase after a prior trend
entry_conditions: for long: price reaches the lower boundary of the range
for short: price reaches the upper boundary of the range
rejection candle forms at the respective boundary
volume is average to above-average at the boundary confirming the zone
RSI near 30-40 for long entries at lower boundary
RSI near 60-70 for short entries at upper boundary
price has not closed outside the range boundaries on the macro timeframe
confirmation_requirements: clear reversal candle at boundary: hammer or bullish engulfing for longs, shooting star or bearish engulfing for shorts
follow-through candle in the direction toward the opposing boundary
volume on confirmation candle above the 10-period average
Stochastic crossing from oversold for longs or from overbought for shorts
price closes back inside the range after any temporary boundary breach
stop_loss_logic: For longs: stop below the lower boundary by 0.5-1 ATR. For shorts: stop above the upper boundary by 0.5-1 ATR. Stops must be tight as range trades have defined invalidation points at zone edges.
take_profit_logic: Target the opposing boundary of the range. For longs: target the upper boundary. For shorts: target the lower boundary. Set TP at 80-90% of the range width to account for zone thickness. No trailing stop needed as price typically stalls near the opposing boundary.
invalidation_conditions: price closes outside the range boundary with a full candle body for two consecutive candles
volume spike accompanying a breakout beyond the range boundary
ADX rises above 25 indicating a trend is forming
major news event causes a gap outside the range
range structure is violated by a candle with a body larger than 50% of the entire range width
price fails to reach the opposing boundary after 10 candles and starts consolidating near the entry level

required_features.range_defined: true with clear upper and lower boundaries
required_features.range_width_in_atr: >2 ATR to provide sufficient profit potential

timeframe_requirements.macro: 1D or 4H to confirm range structure and absence of trend
timeframe_requirements.entry: 1H or 15M for timing entry at boundary with reversal candle

risk_notes: Range trading requires strict discipline at stop levels. Ranges break, and when they do they can move significantly. Do not add to losing positions hoping for a bounce. Keep position sizes smaller than trend trades because ranges can expand unexpectedly. Avoid range trading around major economic events. The most profitable range trades happen in the middle of accumulation phases, not near range boundaries that have been tested many times.

agent_rules.rule: Never range trade unless both upper and lower boundaries have been touched at least twice each.
If ADX rises above 25 while in a range trade, exit immediately — the range may be breaking into a trend.
Set take profit at 80-90% of the range width, not at the exact boundary — ranges rarely touch perfectly on every cycle.
If price breaks the boundary on a high-volume candle, do not fade the move — switch to breakout strategy rules.
Do not enter range trades if a major scheduled news event is within 4 hours.
